mechanism: Additive hypotensive effects from irbesartan combined with anticholinergic-induced fluid retention and potential sympathomimetic effects of oxybutynin, plus oxybutynin is metabolized by CYP3A4 with minor irbesartan metabolism involvement.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly; counsel patient on orthostatic precautions and dehydration avoidance; consider alternative anticholinergic agent with lower systemic absorption if hypotension emerges.
